rub.zh: When you feel an itch, you often scratch it with your fingers by rubbing your nails on the skin.

rule.en: Chefs in France were creating new ways to prepare vegetables, and they started to establish rules for what was considered good food.
rule.zh: 法国的厨师们正在创造准备蔬菜的新方法，他们开始为什么是好食物制定规则。

rule.en: And regulators in the US have started treating fusion as a properly separate category from traditional nuclear power, with lighter rules, because a fusion reactor can't melt down the way a fission reactor can.
rule.zh: 美国的监管机构也已开始将核聚变视为与传统核电完全不同的独立类别，适用的法规更为宽松，因为聚变反应堆不会像裂变反应堆那样发生堆芯熔毁。

rural.en: For centuries, many rural communities had access to common land, right?
rural.zh: 几个世纪以来，许多农村社区都可以使用公共土地，对吧？

rural.en: Britain at that time was a rural society.
rural.zh: 那时的英国是一个乡村社会。
